method.contrast1: per class with at least min_class_n vaults, Spearman of fee rate with each metric; pooled = class-size-weighted mean; null: metric shuffled within class by curator (curator means across curators, deviations within curators, as in E4)
method.contrast1_group: rank-biserial of each metric between fee-charging and zero-fee vaults, same pooling and null
method.contrast2: curator x class cells with two or more fee levels: median metric at the highest fee minus at the lowest; mean over cells; null: fees shuffled within cells
method.contrast3: performance-fee changes with no other change within the window; after minus before of daily tail loss and L over active days; Spearman with the fee change and increase minus decrease means; null: clustered shuffle of the fee change
method.contrast4: curator x class cells on two or more protocols: metric median of the protocol with the higher median fee minus the lower, over protocol pairs; null: protocol fee medians permuted within cells
method.fee_rate: mean over the vault's E4 active days of the performance fee in force at day end (fee_history.csv; Euler lending: the interest fee)
method.loss_per_dollar: sum over depeg-loss events of the vault's loss per dollar (e5); 0 when a depeg-loss t0 falls in its active period without loss, NaN otherwise
method.tail_loss: E4's oracle-aware tail loss (tl_d0150 to tl_d1000 and tl_headline) in the main blocks; the first-pass closed form (tl_v1_*) in appendix_v1

what: the four fee contrasts of docs/experiment.md E6, within collateral class, with permutation p-values clustered by curator
